name: playwright-skill
title_zh: 测试套件越写越稳的 Playwright 实战手册
tagline_zh: 从 Cypress/Selenium 迁过来、CI 里老飘红、选择器一夜全碎？这本手册把踩过的坑写成模式。
tagline_en: Migrating from Cypress/Selenium? Flaky in CI? This is the battle-tested pattern book for selectors, visual.
desc_en: Battle-tested Playwright patterns for writing, debugging, and scaling reliable test suites. Use when you need guidance for E2E, API, component, visual, accessibility, or security testing, plus CI/CD, CLI automation, page objects, and migration from Cypress or Selenium. TypeScript and JavaScript.
why_zh: 不是 API 文档的复读机，是 battle-tested 的决策树：什么时候用 page objec…
why_en: Not an API rehash—a decision tree from real breakage: when to use page objects, when to poll instead of wait, and why.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Playwright 生态内的 TypeScript/JavaScript 项目。
limit_en: TypeScript/JavaScript only. No Python/Java examples, no beginner spec-writing basics—you must already have one passing test.
title_en: Playwright field manual for test suites that stop breaking
